title: Pure Mist Strawberry Mint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Strawberry Mint blends the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the cooling freshness of Mint for a perfectly balanced vape. This unique combination delivers a smooth and satisfying flavour, ideal for vapers who enjoy a mix of fruity and refreshing notes. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers tailored VG/PG ratios to suit different vaping preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Strawberry Mint is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
